title: Neon Nebula
description: Persistent neon waves, falling squares, rising particles and expanding keypress rings.
notes: Original GLSL implementation; no redistributed Canvas source. Preserves all eight controls, three waves and their phase-dependent palette, persistent source-over accumulation, six-color square/ring population, initial teal and expanding color2 tap rings. Native ping-pong feedback never samples the texture being rendered. A fixed 300-particle seeded population replaces random births and the transient 30 growing startup squares; particle radii use their mature sizes. Animation and tap expansion use integrated speed at a normalized 60 Hz reference, while opacity accumulates once per rendered frame. Frame rate, random placement, startup population and antialiasing therefore affect pixel-level results. History clears on restart, resize and shader recompilation. Tap force controls ring opacity; speed changes do not jump an existing ring. No BPM or synthetic keypress is generated.
